quote: Except when traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal: The driver of a vehicle shall stop in obedience to a stop sign or yield in compliance with a yield sign, in compliance with the manner prescribed in subsection 1 [NRS-484B-257-1], prior to entering an intersection if a stop sign or a yield sign is erected at one or more entrances thereto although not a part of a through highway and shall proceed cautiously, yielding to vehicles not so obligated to stop or yield and which are within the intersection or approaching so closely as to constitute an immediate hazard during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection.

activation.condition: Stop or yield sign erected at one or more entrances to a non-through-highway intersection, absent actual police-officer or traffic-signal control

obligation.description: Driver stops for stop sign or yields for yield sign before intersection entry in subsection 1 manner, proceeds cautiously and yields during crossing to non-obligated vehicles within or immediately approaching the intersection

exceptions.trigger: actual traffic control by police officer or traffic-control signal
exceptions.effect: subsection 2 signed-intersection duty is excepted while that control applies
exceptions.replacement_obligation: unresolved under controlling officer or signal rule
exceptions.source_clause: Except when traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal:

timing.description: Signed entrance response before entry; priority to other vehicles assessed while ego moves across or within intersection

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal
judgment_calls_needed.note: An officer-like actor or scripted gesture alone does not establish police authority or actual traffic control.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: in compliance with the manner prescribed in subsection 1 [NRS-484B-257-1]
judgment_calls_needed.note: The incorporated stop/yield manner and entrance references require original sign, body-entry and camera review.
The statute supplies no numerical cautious-speed threshold.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: not so obligated to stop or yield
judgment_calls_needed.note: Other-entrance governance must be checked from original site and sign sources.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: approaching so closely as to constitute an immediate hazard
judgment_calls_needed.note: Hazard proximity and timing remain a qualitative judgment without a statutory numeric cutoff.
Complete body and speed histories support review but cannot themselves determine legal priority.
